candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, which propagates as ReadTimeout 502s through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway propagating ReadTimeout 502s. Inventory metrics show 13.9 reserve_inventory ops with 503s and p95 ~2425ms, consistent with a Redis dependency timeout as the bounded root cause.
